provenance: Direct web-tool opens/clicks of first-party FX URLs. Separate from Python HTTP audit. Numeric origin HTTP status not exposed; null is unknown, never an assumed 200. Search was discovery-only; snippets not accepted as lifecycle evidence.

infrastructure.catalog: /shows -> /shows/all lists titles, including historical series; not a news feed.
infrastructure.headlines: /headlines and show-specific headlines mix first-party articles with external reviews. External destinations are excluded regardless of FX index hosting.
infrastructure.news: Some /news articles have generic Fearless document title and H2 identity. They differ from Lowdown's full article headline.
infrastructure.sitemapsAndRobots: robots.txt, sitemap.xml, sitemap_index.xml and /news index not accessible via web tool; origin status unknown. No guessed API, authentication or bypass.
infrastructure.structuredData: No stable public JSON lifecycle endpoint or documented semantic season grouping established. Raw HTML/JSON-LD presence is a separate runner diagnostic, not proof of such an API.

conclusionScope: Current evidence is insufficient for automatic production under the project's standard. This is not a proof of permanent FX unsuitability or of absence of further first-party articles. No replacement qualification model is validated by this research.
